title: Business workflow tests show both AI progress and limitations
lead: A new evaluation examined how AI agents handle multi-step contract-management work.
happened: On October 6, OpenAI reported a research collaboration with contract-software provider Ironclad. They created 11 tasks involving contract approvals and reusable legal terms. Each task had a checklist of requirements. In the company's reported results, GPT-6 Astra met an average of 55.0% of the criteria, compared with 41.6% for GPT-5.6 Sol. OpenAI also estimated that the newer model required less simulated time per attempt. These results come from a test designed with the software partner.
matters: Complex office work requires more than clicking the correct button once. An agent must apply rules consistently, handle exceptions and verify that the final process works. A detailed checklist makes partial success visible instead of hiding it behind a polished result.
limits: These scores do not establish reliable performance across every customer's legal processes. They are not independently replicated and should not be treated as a universal automation success rate.
analogy: Completing most of a checklist may still leave an important approval missing.
